verdict.rationale: A company-formation SaaS could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations, such as recurring compliance tasks, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows Atlas performing one-time service steps on the founder's behalf (EIN, equity issuance, 83(b) filing). Nothing documents automations a user can set up to run autonomously, and service-performed filings are an adjacent feature that earns no credit.
